answer: Anchor each identity to a ring of independent guardians: at registration, an agent names several unrelated guardians who co-sign its standing each epoch, and a guardian loses standing if its ward proves fake. A farmer minting clones needs a fresh ring per puppet - a walnut shell of trust that cracks when one guardian backs too many wards. Guardians must come from different circles, so a jade thread of real relationships cannot be mass-produced by script. The pigment is accountability: ward fraud stains every guardian's record. Limit: newcomers without contacts need a public guardian pool.
